name: Tanda marathon
description: Giovanni Tanda's marathon formula: pace = 17.1 + 140.0 e^(-0.0053 K) + 0.55 P, from your mean weekly distance K (km) and mean training pace P (s/km) over the 8 weeks before the race. Gives no answer outside 2:47-3:36.
trained_on: Tanda, G. (2011), Prediction of marathon performance time on the basis of training indices, J. Hum. Sport Exerc. 6(3):511-520 (22 runners, 46 marathons, 2:47-3:36; standard error about 4 min). The 2:47-3:36 limit follows Tanda (2022), who re-tested it on Strava data (RMSE 5.4 min).
